title: Girls Looking Out Bus Window, 1972 Church Trip B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Aug. 6, 1972 Lori & Leann leaving from church for Indian Village
description: A square black and white 1972 snapshot capturing two young girls, identified on the back as Lori and Leann, looking through the open window of a passenger bus. Stamped on the front margin 'AUG 72', the handwritten inscription on the reverse notes they were leaving from church for Indian Village on August 6, 1972. This image illustrates mid-century American youth group trips, summer camps, and church-sponsored community activities.
